title: Threat modeling for each system and material change
objective: Model assets, trust boundaries, threats and invariants before building and on each material change, and derive release posture from evidence against those invariants.
residual_risks: Threat models reflect the modelers' imagination; independent review is needed to find omissions.

title: Declared trust boundaries checked against deployment
objective: Declare trust boundaries and data flows as data and verify deployed network, identity and data access configuration against them.

title: Scoped architectural assurance matrix
objective: Publish per release which properties are proven, structurally enforced, empirically tested or unverified, with scope and exclusions; never claim elimination outside the evidenced scope.

title: Independent bypass testing of structural restrictions
objective: Verify, with seeded fixtures and testers who did not build the restriction, that approved interfaces cannot be bypassed.
implementing_systems: Dokimos (exists; code-quality measurement, adversarial role unverified)

title: Validated domain types and explicit states
objective: Model security-relevant values as types with private constructors and validation, model workflows as explicit states with legal transitions only, and enforce exhaustive matching with warnings as errors.
implementing_systems: Ordo state-directed engineering method (exists as a method)

title: Restricted database access architecture
objective: Allow only the application's restricted interface and Strata-governed schema deployments to touch authoritative databases; per-tenant roles with row-level security; no dynamic SQL in database functions; break-glass-only administrative roles.
implementing_systems: Strata (exists; schema governance, pilot, PostgreSQL 16 only)
residual_risks: SEC-DB-001 names Strata as the access path; Strata provides schema governance only, and CNV-ARC-004 assigns authoritative history to an Unbound-owned ledger component. The rule and the architecture disagree.

title: Confined browser execution
objective: Confine application-authored browser script to Limen's kernel, run application logic in WebAssembly without DOM access, accept no user HTML, load no unapproved third-party script, and pin every loaded resource by digest.
residual_risks: Limen's kernel and generated JavaScript glue are themselves script that must be reviewed and tested.
Limen has no independent security review.

title: Security design review before high-risk change
objective: Require documented security design review, independent of the designer, before introducing new data categories, external APIs, autonomous permissions or financial workflows.

title: Fail-closed security decisions and bounded blast radius
objective: Make unknown, failed or timed-out security decisions deny or hold; isolate control-relevant modules and tenant data so a defect in one area cannot silently affect others.
